html:
The capital of Australia, a planned city built from scratch after 1913 in the Australian Capital Territory, between Sydney and Melbourne.

When the colonies joined in the Federation of Australia in 1901, Sydney and Melbourne each wanted to be capital. The compromise was a new city in New South Wales but well away from Sydney. A site was chosen in 1908, on land of the Ngunnawal people.

An international design contest in 1911 and 1912 was won by two Chicago architects, Walter Burley Griffin and Marion Mahony Griffin. Their plan used the hills and valley to frame a city of axes, circles and green space around a central lake. The city was named in 1913.

Building was slow, held up by war, money and quarrels. Parliament moved from Melbourne only in 1927. The lake, named after Griffin, was filled in 1964, and a new Parliament House opened in 1988. Like Washington or Brasília, Canberra was made to be a capital first and a city second.
sum: The capital of Australia, a planned city built from scratch after 1913 in the Australian Capital Territory, between Sydney and Melbourne.
